familiar.noToken: {name}'s familiar "{familiar}" has no token on this scene: the ability did not fire. Shown once per session.

sustain.name: Sustaining: {name}
sustain.desc: The spell is being sustained: the Sustain action is needed each of the caster’s turns. Spell effects bound to the sustaining are removed when this effect goes away.
sustain.offer: {name}: “{spell}” is sustained. Press “Sustain” once per turn; a missed turn or “Dismiss” ends the spell.
sustain.offerQuiet: {name}: "{spell}" can be sustained (the familiar ability fires on Sustain too).
sustain.pulseNoArea: {spell}: no area to template — place the pulse template manually.
sustain.gone: This sustained spell has already ended.
sustain.pick: {name} is sustaining several spells: press “Sustain” on the card of the right one.
sustain.unreachable: End of sustaining “{spell}”: could not remove bound effects on: {list}.
